issues.description: Common DTO de.tum.in.ase.eist.model.Note has inconsistent field type for creationDate between template and solution: template declares `private Instant creationDate;` while solution declares `private String creationDate;`. This breaks cross-repository consistency for a shared model and can confuse students and/or break JSON (de)serialization expectations when comparing starter code to the reference solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Make Note.creationDate identical in both template and solution (field type plus getter/setter signatures). Prefer keeping `Instant creationDate` (as in the template and server NoteService) and adjust the solution's Note.java accordingly.
